proved_general_constants: Every fixed K>0 and alpha in (0,1)
main_claim: Uniform safety at any finite common subsequent time schedule, under the frozen candidate-only oracle and cap T<=2*n_safe, implies liminf_{epsilon->0} sup_{q,Q} E_{pi=q}[T]/n_safe >= 1. Therefore no fixed uniform null-family fractional saving rho<1 is possible.
finite_tradeoff: For the explicit positive finite paired family, max_H TV(mu_H C_H^t,pi_H) >= c_t [a^(E_0 T)-M*r]_+ - p*f >= (63*beta/128)*(a^(E_0 T)-M*r)-p*f.
cap: 1<=T<=2*n_safe; used as M=2*n_safe in history coverage and rare-candidate bound
candidate_count: Every iid proposal draw, including initialization, duplicates and rejections
optional_stopping_accounted_for: Exact full-history coupling and combinatorial average precede Jensen; no fixed-N law receives E[T] as a substitute.
instance_type: Positive finite support of size 2*n_safe(epsilon)^3, with disclosed disjoint-pair symmetric Q; fixed target chosen from hidden label assignments
